title: edges_log rows from the first replay have price_ts after first_shown_at and after the game start
steps: Read sigmaline/app/.data/demo-db.json edges_log, the 6 rows with start_time 2026-11-18
Compare price_ts to first_shown_at and start_time
expected: price_ts (book's own last_update) is not later than first_shown_at, which is before start_time.
actual: e.g. nba-fa3e335565eb02c2: first_shown_at 2026-11-18T00:08:22Z, start 01:11Z, price_ts 03:08:18Z (3 h after logging and after the game). The 5 rows for the later replay (Nov 21) are consistent (price_ts 05:08:55 < first_shown 05:08:56). Also closing_price equals price_taken and clv equals edge_pct exactly on the old rows. Likely demo seed time-shift artifact, not a worker bug; flag only because Results/CLV shown from this data would look wrong. No other log problems found: no duplicate edge_keys, one row per currently shown edge, none logged at/after start, logged price/edge/grade equal market_prices, edge_price_updates is empty (no price changes in demo).
evidence: node analysis of demo-db.json (edges_log vs market_prices/events)
suspected_area: demo seeding (price_ts not rebased with other timestamps); not worker/src/edges.ts
